evidence.note: compute_dot_do_o forms one dot(dO,O) value per query row, scales it by p_dropout, writes dsoftmax_sum, and clears the corresponding dQaccum tile on the non-deterministic path.
The native launch derives grid.x from ceil(seqlen_q/kBlockM), launches kNThreads, and selects Clear_dQaccum=true when deterministic mode is off.

The POD adapter extracts one batch/head tile, guards rows by seqlen_q, strides by logical blockDim.x, and bounds all half/float accesses by seqlen_q*head_dim; responsiveness grade B because geometry and warp assignment are variable but branching is simple.
convert_dQ accumulates fp32 values across nsplits, applies scale_softmax_rp_dropout, converts to the output element type, and stores only in-range seqlen/head-dimension elements.
The native conversion launch uses the same query-block grid, kNThreads, and nsplits=1 or deterministic gridDimx.

The POD adapter compacts one batch/head tile into contiguous split planes and bounds reads by nsplits*seqlen_q*head_dim and writes by seqlen_q*head_dim; responsiveness grade B because scalar-gated grid-stride addressing changes warp assignment but branching is simple.
